- install.sh's replace flag now requires a plain file (-e && ! -L).
- The skill symlink is re-pointed only when recorded in the manifest, never on --update alone.
- The wrapper now logs generated_unix so advancement is provable.

Also confirm the author's empirical result: generated_unix advanced 1795609006 -> 1795609506 across a wrapper run, and uninstall left only refresh.lock.
